title: A General Multimodal Probing Framework for Data Fusion and Prediction with Frozen Large Language Models: Evidence from Multimodal EHR Data
abstract: arXiv:2606.28798v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The main objective of this paper is to propose a general framework for prediction based on different sources of multimodal data in the healthcare domain. We evaluated whether frozen medical large language model (LLM) representations can serve as a shared embedding space for multimodal primary diagnosis category prediction. We propose a backbone-flexible probing framework that serializes structured electronic health record (EHR) variables and leakage-pruned discharge-note sections into a shared frozen-LLM representation space and recovers primary diagnosis categories with linear probes, without fine-tuning the LLM. On a MIMIC-IV cohort of 13,645 admissions (seven diagnosis categories), we probed inputs of different modalities (Structured-only, Unstructured-only, and Combined) across transformer layers and six frozen backbones, compared against XGBoost and three text baselines (CAML, LAAT, PLM-ICD) under a matched split and context bud

translated_title: 基于冻结大语言模型的数据融合与预测通用多模态探测框架：来自多模态电子健康记录数据的证据
translated_abstract: 本文的主要目标是提出一个基于医疗领域不同来源多模态数据进行预测的通用框架。我们评估了冻结的医学大语言模型（LLM）表示能否作为多模态主要诊断类别预测的共享嵌入空间。我们提出了一个骨干网络灵活的探测框架，将结构化电子健康记录（EHR）变量和经过信息泄露剪枝的出院记录章节序列化到共享的冻结LLM表示空间中，并使用线性探针恢复主要诊断类别，而无需对LLM进行微调。在一个包含13,645次住院（七个诊断类别）的MIMIC-IV队列上，我们探测了不同模态的输入（仅结构化、仅非结构化和组合模态）在Transformer各层和六个冻结骨干模型上的表现，并在匹配的数据划分和上下文预算下与XGBoost以及三个文本基线模型（CAML、LAAT、PLM-ICD）进行了比较。
tldr: 提出了一个通用的多模态探测框架，将结构化EHR变量和非结构化出院记录序列化到冻结医学大语言模型的共享表示空间中，通过线性探针实现主要诊断类别预测，无需微调LLM。
en_tdlr: Proposes a general multimodal probing framework that serializes structured EHR variables and unstructured discharge notes into a shared frozen medical LLM representation space, enabling primary diagnosis category prediction via linear probes without fine-tuning the LLM.
